correctness.rationale: All subgroup types reduce to a divisor and a reflection parity. Exact fixed barycentric coordinates identify the orbit graph. Published ambient homotopy ranks give Smith equality. Executed checker verifies 4,711 direct subgroup quotient instances, 4..120 pure reflection quotients and bounded independent GF(2) homology.
